value.header:
import Mathlib
noncomputable section
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace LatticeSL2
def scalarRing (p : ℕ) : Subring ℚ :=
  Subring.closure {q | ∃ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (b : ℚ)⁻¹}
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := ↥(scalarRing p)
instance (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (scalarRing p).subtype).toAlgebra
instance (p : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module (R p) V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap (R p) ℂ)
def divided {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (a : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • a ^ r
def ev {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := divided y i v
abbrev Ix (l : ℤ) := Fin (l.toNat + 1)
def Stable {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (W : Submodule F U) (a : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ W, a u ∈ W
def SimpleTriple {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial U ∧ ∀ W : Submodule F U,
    Stable W x → Stable W y → Stable W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
def Preserves {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (a : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : M, a (m : V) ∈ M
abbrev MR {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := R p ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def LiftOf {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (a : Module.End ℂ V) (f : Module.End ℤ M) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : M, (f m : V) = a (m : V)
instance (p : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :
    IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ V
def L {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ)
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  Submodule.span (R p) (M : Set V)
def J {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ)
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (e : V) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  (L p M).comap ((LinearMap.id : ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).smulRight e |>.restrictScalars (R p))
def pPart {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) (MR p M) :=
  Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range (fun u : MR p M => (p : ℤ) • u))
abbrev Red {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := ZMod p ⊗[ℤ] MR p M
abbrev RK {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] (κ : R p →+* K) (M : Submodule ℤ V) :=
  letI := κ.toAlgebra
  K ⊗[R p] MR p M
abbrev FK {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharP K p] (M : Submodule ℤ V) :=
  letI := ZMod.algebra K p
  K ⊗[ZMod p] Red p M
def throughR {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] (κ : R p →+* K)
    {M : Submodule ℤ V} (f : Module.End ℤ M) : Module.End K (RK κ M) :=
  letI := κ.toAlgebra
  (f.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K
def throughF {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharP K p]
    {M : Submodule ℤ V} (f : Module.End ℤ M) : Module.End K (FK p K M) :=
  letI := ZMod.algebra K p
  (((f.baseChange (R p)).restrictScalars ℤ).baseChange (ZMod p)).baseChange K
def matrixUnit {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    {l : ℤ} (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) F U) (i j : Ix l) : Module.End F U :=
  (B.coord j).smulRight (B i)
def genFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (l : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End F U) (b : Ix l → U) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Ix l, x (b i) = if hi : 0 < i.val then
      ((l - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • b ⟨i.val - 1, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le i.val 1) i.isLt⟩
      else 0) ∧
  (∀ i : Ix l, y (b i) = if hi : i.val + 1 < l.toNat + 1 then
      ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • b ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ else 0) ∧
  (∀ i : Ix l, h (b i) = ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • b i)
def iotaSpec {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (algebraMap (R p) ℂ r) • (m : V)
def canonicalR {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] (κ : R p →+* K)
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (C : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M) : Prop :=
  letI := κ.toAlgebra
  ∀ (c : K) (r : R p) (m : M),
    C (c ⊗ₜ[R p] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) = (κ r * c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m
def pureR {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] (κ : R p →+* K)
    {M : Submodule ℤ V} (c : K) (u : MR p M) : RK κ M :=
  letI := κ.toAlgebra
  c ⊗ₜ[R p] u
def canonicalF {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharP K p]
    (κ : R p →+* K) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (D : FK p K M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M) : Prop :=
  letI := ZMod.algebra K p
  ∀ (c : K) (a : ZMod p) (r : R p) (m : M),
    D (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m))) =
      ((ZMod.cast a : K) * κ r * c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m
def basisOrigin {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] {l : ℤ}
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V)
    (β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧
  ∃ ι : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V, iotaSpec p M ι ∧ Function.Injective ι ∧
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (MR p M),
    (∀ i, ι (B i) = b • ev y v i.val) ∧
  ∃ κ : R p →+* K, ∃ C : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M,
    canonicalR κ M C ∧ ∀ i, β i = C (pureR κ 1 (B i))
end LatticeSL2
open LatticeSL2

Module.Finite ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧ SimpleTriple x y h ∧
 h * x - x * h = (2 : ℂ) • x ∧ h * y - y * h = (-2 : ℂ) • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h ∧
 ∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = (l : ℂ) • w
premise_types.H004: v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = (l : ℂ) • v
premise_types.H005:
(∃ d : ℕ, ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M, ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V, ∀ i, (b i : V) = B i) ∧
 ∀ r : ℕ, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)

value.conclusion_type:
Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
 (∃ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧

 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh → SimpleTriple (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K))
value.representation: λ is the integer l; nonnegative exponents are Nat and I is Fin (l.toNat+1), identified with 0≤i≤λ using H002. V is an arbitrary complex module; x,y,h are its linear action endomorphisms. H003 records the sl₂ Chevalley relations, highest weight and complex irreducibility. M is an arbitrary Submodule ℤ V, equivalently an additive subgroup, with the integer/complex basis and divided-power stability in H005. R is the rational subring generated by inverses of integers not divisible by p; T006 proves it is exactly the specified ℤ_(p). Scalar actions use its inclusion R→ℚ→ℂ. MR is the actual R⊗ℤ M; its image L is used only through the checked iota in T006/T008. J is the coefficient submodule defined by membership in L. VK=K⊗ℤ M uses the tensor commutor identification with the source M⊗ℤ K. Operators are the actual scalar extensions of compatible integral endomorphisms; existence is proved, and compatible lifts are unique. Red=ZMod p⊗ℤ MR is identified with MR/pMR by T018, and FK is its extension to K. RK and FK install only canonical scalar actions internally. matrixUnit B i j sends B j to B i and other basis vectors to zero; multiplication of endomorphisms is composition with the right factor acting first. No Audit A note is a premise, verified Lean theorem or instance assumption; the two M declarations are used directly from pinned Mathlib.

 basisOrigin M y v β ∧ genFormulas l (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K) β) ∧ Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat + 1 ∧ Nontrivial (VK K M)) ∧ (∀ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M,

 ∃ β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M),
 basisOrigin M y v β ∧ genFormulas l (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K) β ∧
 (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
   (DX r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (fx.baseChange K)^r ∧
   (DY r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (fy.baseChange K)^r) ∧

steps.explanation: For a nonzero W choose w, its basis coefficients, and a nonzero coefficient jointly. Apply matrix units and divide by that coefficient to put every basis vector in W. Include the zero case and discharge all temporary choices.

Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
 (∃ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧

 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh → SimpleTriple (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K))
steps.explanation: Choose compatible lattice lifts and divided-power lifts supplied by N002; apply N005 and the matrix-unit invariance argument. Quantify over every compatible triple (unique by subtype injectivity) and include nonzero V_K. This states exactly invariance under the Chevalley action, also in characteristic 2.

P.explanation: All original data are universally quantified: p:ℕ, arbitrary field K with CharP K p, integer l with 0≤l<p, arbitrary complex V and Chevalley action, chosen highest vector v, and arbitrary admissible M. H003 expresses the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂ representation by its three action operators, finite dimension l+1, relations and highest vector; these determine the same action via the sl₂ presentation. M as a ℤ-submodule is exactly an additive subgroup. H005's finite integer basis also being a complex basis is admissibility, and stability under all divided-power generators is equivalent in both directions to U_Z-stability. Fin(l.toNat+1) identifies with the specified integer interval because H002 gives l≥0. VK=K⊗ℤ M is naturally isomorphic to M⊗ℤ K by swapping tensor factors; T017–T020 use these canonical scalar changes, not a replacement lattice. Compatible integral lifts exist by T008 and are unique by inclusion M→V, so quantifying over every compatible triple yields exactly the induced operators; the existence conjunct rules out vacuity. Nontrivial VK means V(K)≠0. SimpleTriple quantifies over all K-linear subspaces and says that invariance under x,y,h implies zero or the whole space. Since these span the original Chevalley Lie action, this is exactly L(K)-irreducibility. Conversely the source conclusion gives this nontriviality and every such subspace dichotomy under the same unique lifts. No algebraic-closure assumption, distinct reduced weights, p>2 or l>0 is imposed, so p=2 and l=0 remain included.

value.N001: n=λ+1>0 and |I|=n. For every integer t≥0, h y^t v=(λ−2t)y^t v; for t≥1, x y^t v=t(λ−t+1)y^(t−1)v. The vectors (e_i)_{i∈I} form a complex basis of V, and y^(λ+1)v=0 (hence all higher lowering powers vanish). On this basis, xe_0=0, xe_i=(λ−i+1)e_(i−1) for 1≤i≤λ, ye_i=(i+1)e_(i+1) for 0≤i<λ, ye_λ=0, he_i=(λ−2i)e_i. For all i∈I and natural r, X_r e_i=binom(λ−i+r,r)e_(i−r) if r≤i and zero otherwise; Y_r e_i=binom(i+r,r)e_(i+r) if i+r≤λ and zero otherwise. All displayed divided-power coefficients are integers.
value.N002: iota embeds M_R as the R-span of M in V; M_R is free of rank n over R and its complex span is V. Each X_r and Y_r (r≥0) preserves M and M_R, and x,y,h preserve M and M_R. For every i,j∈I, E_ij preserves M_R (under iota). The following identities hold on V: Pi=Y_λ X_λ=E_λλ, X_(λ−i)Pi=E_iλ, Pi Y_(λ−j)=binom(λ,j)E_λj, and E_ij=binom(λ,j)^(-1) X_(λ−i)Pi Y_(λ−j), where binom(λ,j) is a unit in R.
value.N003: For every i∈I one has J_i=J. The R-module J⊂ℂ is nonzero and finitely generated. The map (c_i)_{i∈I}↦∑_{i∈I}c_i e_i is an R-linear isomorphism ∏_{i∈I}J→iota(M_R), so, identifying M_R through iota, M_R=⊕_{i∈I}J e_i.
value.N004: The multiplication map ℚ⊗_R J→ℂ is injective and its image is the rational span of J, a one-dimensional ℚ-vector space. There exists b∈J with b≠0 and J=Rb. For any such b, the family (b e_i)_{i∈I} is an R-basis of M_R identified with iota(M_R).
value.N005: The natural tensor maps give K-linear isomorphisms V_K≅M_R⊗_R K≅(M_R/pM_R)⊗_(F_p)K, intertwining all lattice operators. There exists a K-basis (b_i)_{i∈I} of V_K obtained from an R-basis (b e_i) of M_R with b∈J nonzero. In particular dim_K(V_K)=n=λ+1>0. On this basis the induced operators satisfy xb_0=0, xb_i=(λ−i+1)b_(i−1) for 1≤i≤λ, yb_i=(i+1)b_(i+1) for i<λ, yb_λ=0, hb_i=(λ−2i)b_i, with integer coefficients interpreted in K. For every 0≤r≤λ, r! is nonzero in K and the induced divided powers X_r,Y_r equal (r!)^(-1)x^r,(r!)^(-1)y^r. Every binom(λ,j) for j∈I is nonzero in K. The reduced operators T_ij=binom(λ,j)^(-1) X_(λ−i)(Y_λ X_λ)Y_(λ−j), for i,j∈I, obey T_ij b_k=δ_jk b_i for every k∈I, where δ_jk is 1 for j=k and 0 otherwise.
value.P: V_K is nonzero, and for every K-linear subspace W⊆V_K, if W is invariant under the induced x,y,h then W={0} or W=V_K. Equivalently V(K) is irreducible as an L(K)-module. This holds for every given prime p, field K of characteristic p, integer 0≤λ<p, and arbitrary admissible lattice M, including λ=0 and p=2, without assuming K algebraically closed.

value.text: Set z=y^(λ+1)v. F001 gives hz=(−λ−2)z. Expand z in the basis F003. For every coordinate i∈I, its coefficient is annihilated by (λ−2i)−(−λ−2)=2(λ+1−i), a nonzero complex integer. Every coefficient is zero, so z=0. All higher y powers of v vanish by applying further y powers. Division by i! in F001 now gives xe_0=0, xe_i=(λ−i+1)e_(i−1) for i≥1, ye_i=(i+1)e_(i+1) for i<λ, ye_λ=0 and he_i=(λ−2i)e_i.
